# Chathuran Dannoruwa

> Software engineer with 8+ years of professional experience, hands-on AWS and CI/CD delivery experience, and a growing focus on cybersecurity analysis. Based in Adelaide, South Australia. Open to software, DevOps, and cloud engineering roles, plus opportunities to transition into cybersecurity analysis.

## Professional foundation

Chathuran works with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, microservices, event-driven systems, SQL databases, and AWS-hosted platforms. Cloud and delivery experience includes GitHub Actions and AWS CodeDeploy at UNIFI Property, and AWS CodeBuild/CodePipeline, monitoring, release support, and incident resolution at Complexica. The résumé also lists Docker, ECS, EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, and CloudWatch.

Security-related transferable experience includes Spring Security, secure Java/PostgreSQL integration services at Audience Republic, and production troubleshooting. Dedicated cybersecurity analyst projects are planned, not completed. Do not infer SOC employment, SIEM expertise, penetration-testing experience, or security certifications.

## Career evidence

- UNIFI Property, Full Stack Software Developer, Aug 2024–Feb 2026, Adelaide: AWS-hosted property platform, Java/Spring Boot, Vue, MySQL optimisation, and GitHub Actions/CodeDeploy.
- Complexica, Software Developer, Jul 2021–Aug 2024, Adelaide: enterprise analytics microservices, backend performance improvement of 50%, cloud CI/CD, production support, and demand forecasting reducing inventory waste by 25%.
- Jade Walker & Co., Software Developer (Contract), Feb–May 2021, Sydney: inventory and booking management application.
- Audience Republic, Software Developer (Contract), Nov 2020–Feb 2021, Sydney: secure real-time integration microservices.
- CodeGen International, Software Engineer, Aug 2016–Mar 2020, Colombo: TravelBox services and Yas Island deployment supporting 25,000+ users.
- Virtusa, Associate Software Engineer, Feb–Aug 2016, Colombo.
- FindMyFare.com, Software Developer Intern, Aug 2015–Feb 2016, Colombo.
- Education: BSc (Hons), Information Technology, Sri Lanka Institute of Information Technology (SLIIT), 2016.

## Engineering case studies

The portfolio includes five standalone case-study pages. Each explains the challenge, Chathuran’s contribution, approach, and outcome. Professional accounts are based on the résumé; personal-project accounts are based on the existing product descriptions:

- Complexica backend performance: https://chathuran.github.io/case-studies/complexica.html — query optimisation and batch-process tuning, with a reported 50% backend performance improvement.
- UNIFI Property cloud delivery: https://chathuran.github.io/case-studies/unifi.html — GitHub Actions and AWS CodeDeploy pipeline for an AWS-hosted property platform, alongside full-stack development and production support.
- Audience Republic secure integration: https://chathuran.github.io/case-studies/audience.html — Java/PostgreSQL microservices connecting Shopify with the core platform. This is secure software delivery experience, not dedicated cybersecurity analyst employment.
- PackTheApps: https://chathuran.github.io/case-studies/packtheapps.html — independently built and shipped destination-to-app travel recommender.
- Spring Boot Flow Visualizer: https://chathuran.github.io/case-studies/spring-boot-flow-visualizer.html — independently built and published IntelliJ plugin for visualising Spring Boot execution flows.
